issue.title: Illegal eviction and security deposit non-refund
issue.description: Tenant is being illegally evicted and the security deposit has not been refunded.

facts: Tenant has been residing at the premises under a valid rental agreement.
Landlord has demanded vacation of premises without proper legal notice.
Security deposit of ₹30,000 has not been returned despite completion of tenancy.
rights: Tenant may have a right to proper notice before eviction.
Tenant may have a right to refund of security deposit.

laws.title: Protection Against Illegal Eviction
laws.explanation: Dummy legal information for testing tenant rights.

recommended_actions: Document all communications with the landlord.
Send a formal legal notice demanding refund of security deposit.
